lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Performance task planning: parentheses and brackets

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example shows how to justify a modelling choice.

steps: The parentheses show that 5 × 12 is treated as one quantity.
The result of a multiplication is a product.
The outside operation subtracts 3 from that product.
workedSolution.answer: Multiply 5 by 12, then subtract 3 from the product.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Decide what the quantities are before you compute anything.

items.prompt: Pattern A starts at 13 and adds 15. Pattern B starts at 5 and adds 13. What are the corresponding terms at term 5?

Pattern A: 7, 18, 29, 40
Pattern B: 14, 36, 58, 80
Which statement describes the relationship between corresponding terms?
choices: Each term in Pattern A is 2 times the corresponding term in Pattern B.
Each term in Pattern A is 1/3 of the corresponding term in Pattern B.
Each term in Pattern B is 2 times the corresponding term in Pattern A.
Each term in Pattern B is 3 times the corresponding term in Pattern A.

items.prompt: Pattern A starts at 17 and adds 11. Pattern B starts at 1 and adds 11. Using Pattern A as x and Pattern B as y, which point represents term 10?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Plan in writing: what you will model, why that model, and how you will check it.

items.prompt: 9737 counters are split into 91 equal groups. Which pair of equations represents the model?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A rectangle has area 510 square units and one side length is 15 units. What is the missing side length?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt:
Use these partial-quotients steps to solve 6355 ÷ 85:
6355 - 85 × 70 = 405
405 - 85 × 4 = 65
What is the quotient and remainder?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
